definitions.feature_values: four statistics of log1p(COT); not four physical-COT statistics
definitions.saturation: No output clipping; log101 exceedance is a diagnostic of reference-range exceedance, not numerical saturation.
definitions.feature_tail: mean-log1p tail is not pixel-COT tail; center describes one pixel only.
definitions.sample_scope: nearest shard with labeled rows to first/middle/last train and val shard starts; first eligible sequence in each; 6 deterministic sequences, not representative

limitations: Train/validation feature differences mix seasons and do not measure real-vs-forecast R domain error.
CPU reload witnesses reuse frozen predicted AGRI and do not independently rerun S.
Only six shards are revisited here; previous full shard acceptance is separately hash-bound.
No new real-AGRI or CPP reference pairing; retrieval degradation or its causal role in the pilot is unestablished.
